name: Wo Zai Nuzi Jianyu Kai Hougong
source:
One day you were dispatched to a women's prison to take charge of the lives of the female prisoners and explore the inner secrets of those girls. There are six girls to be explored.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1527980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，你被派往一所女子监狱，负责掌管女囚犯的生活，并探索那些女孩内心的秘密。有六个女孩需要探索。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1527980/]Steam[/url]]
